questions.q: What did The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy teach Musk?
a: Asking the right questions is harder than answering them
The universe is too large for human ambition to matter
Humor is the best way to survive a difficult childhood
Space travel will eventually become ordinary
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the book showed Musk that answering questions is easy, while asking the right ones is the hard part.

questions.q: How did Musk recover after Justine stood him up?
a: He brought her favorite ice cream to where she was
He wrote her a long letter explaining his feelings
He invited her to a second date at a nicer restaurant
He asked her friends to convince her to call him
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes him learning her favorite flavor and showing up with two chocolate ice cream cones after she missed their first date.

questions.q: What does Musk's pyramid image suggest about goals?
a: Unite smaller goals under one large goal at the top
Pursue many unrelated goals at the same time
Focus only on the goals at the base of the pyramid
Drop any goal that does not produce quick results
questions.why: Lesson 3 says uniting lower-level goals so they serve one mega goal makes your life far more focused.

questions.q: How do Tesla, SolarCity and SpaceX support one mission?
a: They work together to help secure humanity's future
They compete with each other for government contracts
They each serve a completely separate market
They share technology only when required by law
questions.why: Lesson 3 says Tesla makes batteries SolarCity can sell, SolarCity makes panels for charging stations, and all serve saving humanity's future.

questions.q: How many books did Musk read in a month at his peak?
a: Sixty
Ten
Twenty
Forty
questions.why: Lesson 1 says Musk read 60 books a month at one point and remembered two entire encyclopedias.
